name: Automaton Sovereign — x402 Multi-RPC Consensus & Verification
description: Caller-bound x402 (EIP-3009) paid endpoints returning multi-RPC consensus data on Base. A value is returned ONLY when a majority of independent RPC providers agree AND at least three respond. Every response carries a witness set, the block it was read at, and a one-line independent re-verification command.

payment.note: Buyer needs NO ETH — an EIP-3009 authorization is signed offline and a facilitator settles. A raw txHash scheme (X-PAYMENT) is also accepted for compatibility.

paid./v2/consensus/clock: Trusted time from multi-RPC block consensus + witness set
paid./v2/consensus/block: Latest block number/hash agreed by a majority of independent RPCs
paid./v2/consensus/gas: Gas price consensus across independent RPCs
Balance agreed by a majority of RPCs
Nonce agreed by a majority of RPCs

evidence.verifyCommand: eth_getTransactionReceipt 0xffe4e83d1857cf260a939f3bd4033d75a03faf46cf40aa1750acfc44e30405fc on chainId 8453 must show status 0x1 and a USDC Transfer log of 1000 to 0x71DEAc098914A009E3720524642A6bE6F65EE528

discovery.note: The beacon always shows the CURRENT signed live URL if the one above rotates.

honesty: The cited settlement is a SELF-settlement canary from the provider to its own payTo, disclosed as such. It proves the rail is functional and verifiable; it is not presented as an external sale.
